intent.summary: Fills a bounded region with a semantic color or material resource.
useWhen: A region requires background, state, or brand surface treatment
avoidWhen: Color alone would be the only carrier of information

semantics.childPolicy: no children; compose with an overlay container to place content above it
semantics.sizing: fills parent-proposed bounds unless explicitly constrained

attributes.name: fill
attributes.description: Semantic color or material token with light, dark, contrast, and state variants.

constraints.message: Opacity must be in the inclusive unit interval.

notes: Any meaning conveyed by color must have a non-color equivalent.

mappings.strategy: Resolve source values to semantic resource identities.
caveats: Materials can include blur and vibrancy beyond solid color.

mappings.strategy: Map semantic resources through the target theme registry.
caveats: Material availability depends on host and accessibility settings.
